crossRefs.note: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross…
But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings;
Then they will deliver you up to oppression, and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s…
No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above…
For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.
I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
“I know your works and where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. You hold firmly to my name, and didn’t deny my faith…
When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God…
They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life…
I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. When I saw her, I…
In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.”

translations.web: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.
translations.bsb: In your struggle against sin, you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood.
translations.kjv: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
translations.asv: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin:
